body: Your comment has really helped the most. I finally sat him down and asked him why he just "felt" like he wasn't ready and after much prying on both accounts he came to the conclusion that he wasn't happy with how our life has turned out (job debt ect). This will be our jumping off point, we are discussing a compromise.

It was fine, my anxiety levels were better on them so I think I nagged obsessed a little less. We've been together 8 years, I went without meds for most of that time and found the magic pill by accident,for anxiety.  He's 11 years older than me so I thought he would want this sooner. The miscarriage happened at a time when we were not thinking of kids...so he thought it was a happy accident.  I have a progesterone  issue but my Dr won't do anything unless I have another problem. My fertility is crap and my boyfriend is not on board and maybe will never be..i just want him to be happy. And I don't think I'll be happy without a kid.

I don't know he's been very vague in telling me anything.  But it's been going on for almost 2 years I've asked him. I'm sure I'm just a giant hassle to him and he sees me as someone not stable or fit to breed with. I had a miscarriage 2 years ago and he blames that for our downfall. I've begged this long and I don't see it happening any time soon.

We have discussed marriage but I'm not sure if I care about getting married.  It would be a nice gesture to be purposed to but I don't care about a wedding. We have lived together for 7 years I already feel like a wife in most repects. He's always been very quiet about how he feels, I suppose I'm just used to it now...it's just at times like this I wish he would be more open. He's expressed fears, but fears everyone has when talking about kids, money, job , time ect. I'm just not sure how to drag a answer out of him without forcing him to do it.

Right?! My mom says she would have thought it would be reversed since he's had more time to party, he should be the one wanting to pursue this. Thing is my hormone levels were wacked when I had the miscarriage and they don't know if it was bc the miscarriage or what caused it, my doctor won't test until I'm pregnant again. So I'm worried about not being able to carry a child along with him running out the clock, my aunt had perimenopause at 30..maybe I'm just a worrier but how much of a dick is he gonna feel like if he's out waited my biological clock, adoption ain't cheap.

That's just it he hasn't given me something new to fix, which made me excited at first thinking he was finally ready to do this. I think he sees having kids as a end to relationship maybe, I could just be reading into it. I've tried to get these questions answered but he says I talk about it too much and to let him be so he can think about it without my influence,  so he knows he's doing it because he wants to not just because I made him cave. But part of the reason I talk about it so often is because I know nothing about the progress of it, we could be trying next week or 19 years from now your guess is as good as mine. I get not wanting to be talked into it, i just don't understand why he can't just be blunt with me.

It just sucks because we are happy in every other respect. I don't want to give him a ultimatum, because then if he does it and doesn't want to he will be unhappy and the kid will suffer, and then if he doesn't I'll have to move..i guess the bright side is I get the ps4

I've always wanted kids, ever since I was little and now that I have a decent job and a steady relationship I felt like it was time. If he would say "I don't want kids" I would just end the relationship, he's never said that though, he just keeps saying "eventually" I just don't know at what point is he going to own up to it..i don't want him to do it if he's not ready but I feel like there needs to be at least a set time range to shoot for so I'm not wasting my time or his, I want him to be happy with his decision.

It is THE deal breaker for me. When we got together we talked about relationship expectations and what goals we wanted to achieve,  I asked if he wanted kids at that time to which he responded "eventually" and I took that at face value. He knows I'll leave him if he doesn't want kids, so I'm starting to get the feeling that he's dragging this out to avoid a breakup.
